title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry — Registry Credit Terms
content:
Registry credit is the value held on a Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry from registry gifts the registrant returned, not yet spent or converted to a merchandise credit card.

1. **Spending.** Registry credit can be spent by the registrant on any Marlowe & Finch merchandise purchase while the registry is active or in completion, up to the registry credit balance.
   *Status: no longer in force for registry credit the registrant applies to her or his own order line (the registrant's purchase record still in ordered status), which is governed by the current basis for such lines. Every other spending of registry credit remains under this clause.*
2. **Conversion.** Within the registry type's conversion period in calendar days after the registry closes or is cancelled, the whole remaining balance is converted once into a merchandise credit card in the registrant's name.
3. **No cash.** Registry credit is never paid out in cash or to a card account.

| Registry status | What happens to registry credit |
|---|---|
| active or completion | can be spent by the registrant |
| closed or cancelled | the remaining balance is converted once into a merchandise credit card in the registrant's name |
| any | never paid in cash or to a card account |

**Illustration (hypothetical).** A registry closes holding USD 64.10 of registry credit. Within the conversion period, the whole USD 64.10 is converted in a single conversion into a merchandise credit card in the registrant's name; it is not split, and it is not refunded to the registrant's credit card.

superseded_clauses: Registry credit can be spent by the registrant on any Marlowe & Finch merchandise purchase (registry_credit_usable_for) while the registry is active or in completion, up to the registry_credit_balance.
